# Claude Code Undocumented

An undocumented item is a part of Claude Code that the program has but the official docs do not name.
Claude Code `2.1.303` has many of them, such as env vars, flags, and hook fields.
They can change or vanish in any release, so use them with care.

## Example

Set the env var `CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_MODE=1` to turn on coordinator mode, where the main session hands work to helpers.

## How We Found Them

We read the strings in the program and the type file that comes with it.
Then we ran the program against a local stub API, to see what it does with a value.
The method and the results are on the page [Probes](Claude-Code-Probes).
